articles.title: Russia warns drone plans for Ukraine are pulling Europe deeper into war
articles.summary: Russia's defence ministry issued a stern warning, stating that European plans to escalate drone supplies to Ukraine are drawing those nations deeper into a war with Russia. This highlights Russia's escalating concerns over Western military aid to Kyiv, implying potential retaliatory measures or further worsening of geopolitical tensions between Moscow and the European Union over the ongoing conflict.

articles.title: Searchlight Pictures Lands SXSW Breakout Pic ‘Monitor’ From Matt Black And Ryan Polly
articles.summary: Searchlight Pictures acquired U.S. rights for "Monitor," the debut horror film by Matt Black and Ryan Polly. The movie premiered in the Mignighter section at SXSW, marking a significant acquisition for the emerging filmmakers. This deal highlights the entertainment industry's interest in new talent and genre cinema, signaling potential future success for the acclaimed debut.

articles.title: France forward Ekitike to miss World Cup after rupturing Achilles tendon
articles.summary: France's star striker Hugo Ekitike is confirmed to miss the upcoming World Cup due to a ruptured Achilles tendon. Manager Didier Deschamps announced the unfortunate news on April 15. Ekitike sustained the severe injury during Liverpool's recent Champions League defeat, ruling him out of the prestigious international tournament. This is a significant blow for the French national team's preparations.
